resources.string: The passcodes didn\'t match. Please start again
If you forget your passcode, you can confirm with your phone\'s screen lock and set a new one. Anyone who knows your phone\'s screen lock can also open your diary this way.
Confirm with your phone\'s screen lock
After you confirm it\'s you with your phone\'s screen lock, you can set a new passcode. Your diary stays as it is.
Your phone has no screen lock
Without a screen lock, you can\'t set a new passcode. If you have a backup, reinstall the app and restore your diary from it.
Your phone has no screen lock, so the diary lock is now off. Set a new passcode in Settings
Biometrics aren\'t available on this device right now
When you come back from another app after the time you chose, the diary locks again.
Only when the app starts fresh
If you forget your passcode, you can confirm with your phone\'s screen lock and set a new one.
